apps.name: Ludo
apps.summary: Offline Ludo on a 3D board, with bots and Same Wi-Fi play
apps.description: Classic Ludo on a tilted 3D board. Play against Easy, Medium or Hard bots, pass the phone, or play with phones on the same Wi-Fi with no internet. House rules, auto-saved games, English and Hindi, no ads.
apps.changelog: - Ludo 1.0.0: offline, bots, pass & play, Same Wi-Fi

apps.name: Bhoomi Converter
apps.summary: Indian land units by state, with a 3D plot view
apps.description: Converts bigha, biswa, kanal, marla, katha, guntha and more into sq ft, gaj, acre and hectare for your state, lets you set your local bigha size, and shows the plot in 3D beside a football field. Works offline in eight languages.
apps.changelog:
- Six more languages, release size and README
- Local units, Language and 3D plot screens
- Project skeleton, conversion engine, Convert screen and state picker
